{{Short description|Argentine mathematician}}
'''Laura Felicia Matusevich''' is an [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[mathematician]].<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web |url=https://www.lathisms.org/calendar-2016/laura-matusevich |title=Lathisms |date=April 17, 2022 |website= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417195057/https://www.lathisms.org/calendar-2016/laura-matusevich |archive-date=17 April 2022 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Birth and Education==
Matusevich was born in [[Córdoba, Argentina]], and earned her undergraduate degree from the [[National University of Córdoba|Universidad Nacional de Córdoba]].<ref name="auto2"/> She earned her PhD from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 2002.<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web |url=https://www.math.tamu.edu/people/formalpg.php?user=laura |title=Laura Felicia Matusevich, Department of Mathematics, Texas A&M University |date=May 1, 2021 |website= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210501115924/https://www.math.tamu.edu/people/formalpg.php?user=laura |archive-date=1 May 2021 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="auto">{{Cite web |url=https://www.math.tamu.edu/~laura/ |title=Home |website=www.math.tamu.edu |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220404021551/https://www.math.tamu.edu/~laura/ |archive-date=4 April 2022 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Career==
From 2003 until 2004 Matusevich was a [[Benjamin Peirce]] Assistant Professor at [[Harvard University]]. From 2004 until 2006 she was a tenure-track assistant professor at the [[University of Pennsylvania]]. In 2005, she began as a tenure-track assistant professor at [[Texas A&M University]], where she became a tenure-track associate professor in 2009. She became a full professor there in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://mosaic.math.tamu.edu/undergraduate/research/491-faculty/491-faculty.html |title=Undergraduate Research, Department of Mathematics, Texas A&M University |date=March 12, 2016 |website= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160312002802/https://mosaic.math.tamu.edu/undergraduate/research/491-faculty/491-faculty.html |archive-date=12 March 2016 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="auto1"/>

==Publications==
Matusevich has published 34 research articles as of the 16th of March 2022.<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Laura-Felicia-Matusevich-11208827 |title=Laura Felicia Matusevich's research works &#124; Texas A&M University, Texas (TAMU) and other places |date=March 16, 2022 |website= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220316192524/https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Laura-Felicia-Matusevich-11208827 |archive-date=16 March 2022 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Recognition==
Matusevich is the recipient of multiple awards and honors, having been an [[Sloan Research Fellowship|Alfred P. Sloan Research Fellow]], a [[National Science Foundation|NSF]] Postdoctoral Fellow, and an Antorchas Fellow (one of 25 people awarded this nationwide in Argentina), among others.<ref name="auto"/>
